name: flywheel-mod
description: Holds risky Bash, PowerShell and file-edit calls with the Flywheel pre-action monitor, writes a hash-chained receipt for every turn, and shows held and passed counts above the prompt. Adds holds only; never approves a call.

python.title: Python
python.description: Python interpreter that can import the Flywheel monitor (harness.preaction).

monitor_source.title: Monitor source folder
monitor_source.description: Folder holding Flywheel's harness/ package. Required: when empty, every screened call is treated as unchecked.

monitor_home.title: Monitor home
monitor_home.description: Where the monitor keeps its records and open holds. Relative paths resolve in the project folder.

monitor_owner_config.title: Monitor owner config
monitor_owner_config.description: Optional owner config file passed to the monitor as --owner-config.

monitor_timeout_ms.title: Monitor timeout (ms)
monitor_timeout_ms.description: How long one monitor run may take before the call counts as unchecked.

monitor_deadline_seconds.title: Monitor internal deadline (s)
monitor_deadline_seconds.description: The monitor's own deadline, after which it fails the call closed.

screen.title: Which calls the monitor sees
screen.description: rules: only calls the risk pre-filter flags. all: every guarded call.

on_unavailable.title: When the monitor cannot answer
on_unavailable.description: deny: refuse the call and say why (fail closed). pass: let it go on to Claude Code's own permission check (fail open).

status_site.title: Where the status line goes
status_site.description: band: above the prompt, kept beside other mods' drawings. status: the line under the prompt. off: nowhere.

receipts_dir.title: Receipts folder
receipts_dir.description: Where turn receipts go. Relative paths resolve in the project folder.
